title: How Ann-Sophie Schälicke Redefines Inclusive Fashion With Clo
description:
Discover the story of Ann-Sophie Schälicke, a Germany-based designer redefining inclusive fashion with her brand A. Schaelicke. Through her participation in the Design Academy ADAPT program co-hosted by VORN – The Berlin Fashion Hub and Zalando, she discovered CLO, which enabled her to create adaptive designs for all body types. For Ann-Sophie, CLO isn’t just a tool; it’s the key to making her inclusive vision a reality.

Learn more about Design Academy ADAPT program: https://vorn-hub.com/design-academy-adapt-1
Learn more about A. Schaelicke: https://www.instagram.com/a.schaelicke/?hl=en

summary: # How Ann-Sophie Schälicke Redefines Inclusive Fashion With Clo ## Introduction Hi, my name is Ann-Sophie Schälicke, and I'm a German-based fashion designer dedicated to inclusive fashion. I saw the lack in the market regarding accessibility and the gaps not only in the products but also in the representation of the whole industry. I wanted to close the gap and make shows with purpose. It’s not just fabric; it’s like an ally in your everyday life that supports and empowers you. ## The Spotlight Collection My first step into adaptive fashion was my inclusive graduate collection in 2023, named "Spotlight." I chose this name because I wanted the disabled community to take center stage. It stands out because of its innovative closures, using magnets, bold font prints, and futuristic silhouettes. ## The Design Academy The Design Academy is an educational program co-hosted by Vaughan, the Berlin Fashion Hub, and Zalando. The third edition of this program focuses on creating innovation in adaptive fashion. It gave me the opportunity to connect with like-minded designers and incredible industry experts, providing me with the right tools for my work. It’s also where I discovered Clo. ## The Role of Clo The most helpful tool of Clo for me is the virtual try-on feature, which includes avatar and pose customization, as well as fabric simulation. This allows me to adjust the body types of my customers. For example, I can create designs for seated positions for wheelchair users. The simulation helps me adjust the fit for these specific needs. ## Innovative Design Techniques I use magnets and special pattern cutting for the body position so that the clothing looks flattering while standing and also while sitting. For me, it shows more than just the software; it's a tool that empowers me to design in a way that aligns with my physical strengths. I no longer need to rely on physical strength and can focus solely on designing. ## Overcoming Challenges Even in my toughest moments, when I was hospitalized, I could work on my adaptive pieces with Clo. The tool gave me freedom and flexibility to do my work from anywhere. Clo has provided me with the tools to bring my vision to life with more precision and creativity. I am excited to see how it evolves in the future of adaptive fashion. ## Looking Ahead I truly think I’m just at the beginning of this journey, and I’m really excited to see where it takes me. To be continued. ## Conclusion We start at the end of the seminar. So, we’ll see you next time. Remember, the move is not the move; we are always moving forward. We will never stop, so stay positive and keep moving forward. We’ve been through hard times, and we must continue to push ahead. We will see you next time. Bye!
